title: Engineering discipline and performance

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

allowedWork: Approved portfolio permits independent slice selection and local review parking
disallowedWork: New visual or semantic behavior without review
goal: Improve measured loading, resources, repeated work and real authoring APIs with preserved behavior
commitCadence: Verified coherent commits and hourly or handoff backups
stopConditions: Eight elapsed hours with final two hours reserved; user pause, safety or external blocker, no justified eligible work, or human judgment with no independent remaining work

slices.title: Baseline
slices.summary: Measured complete reader/editor baselines and identified bounded repairs; unrelated workflow metadata preserved.

slices.title: Loading
slices.summary: Checked exact descriptor projections and complete production loading savings.

slices.title: Lifetime
slices.summary: Visibility lifetime consolidation and regression repair verified; retained-scene eviction remains outside preserved behavior.

slices.title: Preparation
slices.summary: Issued-draft reuse removes duplicate check; no cache. Authority, stale requests, disposal and real history preserved.

slices.title: Authoring
slices.summary: Concise preparePreview with two real callers; domain publication and native ownership preserved.

slices.title: Consolidation
slices.summary: Consolidated four revision staging callers with executable boundary guard and preserved host behavior.
